The same domain is weakened when online interaction displaces face-to-face contact, encourages impatience and intolerance, exposes users to cyberbullying and turns social connection into compulsive attention-seeking. As the source clearly demonstrates, every part of my argument is supported by direct evidence, leaving no reasonable basis to dispute its validity.
